name: Cave Pagoda
kicker: Hill pagoda on the slope of Núi Sam
summary: Cave pagoda on the slope of Núi Sam: climb for the view over the plain, and the caves if you have time. Phước Điền is the other name. The halls at the foot are a separate walk. Go when you can see the delta from the slope. The view from the climb reaches toward Cambodia.
getThere: Continue up from the temples at the foot of Núi Sam.
heroCaption: A pavilion on the slope of Núi Sam, with the delta plain behind it

notice.title: The climb starts above the foot
notice.body: Miếu Bà Chúa Xứ and Chùa Tây An sit at the foot of Núi Sam. Chùa Hang, also called Phước Điền, is on the slope, with caves in the hillside. Plan the walk up as its own effort.

body: Continue up from the temples at the foot. The view from the climb reaches toward Cambodia, and caves run into the hillside if you have time. Phước Điền is the other name for this pagoda. The pavilion and the plain are the view you climbed for.
The building sits against the rock, with a path and a statue on the stone. That is the climb. The shrine at the gate below is a different stop. Come when you can see the plain.
Treat the cable car, when it is running, as its own ride up the hill.

figures.caption: The pagoda against the rock, and the path up Núi Sam
figures.alt: Cave Pagoda built into the rock of Sam Mountain, with a white statue in front

gettingThere: Chùa Hang is on the slope of Núi Sam, above the foot-of-the-hill cluster in phường Vĩnh Tế. Start from the shrine road and continue up on foot.
admissionNote: Check on arrival. The cable car is a separate ride.
